subject: Renewal + capacity add — PO, billing contact & W-9 for BrightPath Analytics
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jordan <emma.jordan@brightpath.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity add — PO, billing contact & W-9 for BrightPath Analytics

Hi Emma,

Great to be continuing the partnership — excited to get the renewal and capacity increase finalized. Per our renewal call, BrightPath is renewing for 12 months effective 2028-11-01 and adding an additional 10M token capacity to the Dedicated pool (deal BRP-4821).

To get the expansion invoiced on the first renewal invoice we need three things from your side:
- A purchase order (PO) referencing the Redwood quote (attached).
- Confirm the billing entity name & AP email for invoice delivery.
- A completed W-9 so finance can create the billing account.

Attached: renewal_quote_BRp-4821.pdf (line-item breakdown + SOW reference).

Can you confirm whether the PO will be issued this week and if invoices should be sent to ap@brightpath.com? If BrightPath prefers different net terms from our standard Net30, let me know and I can tee up the internal approval flow.

Thanks — I’ll loop Rafael and our billing ops (Vivek) once we have the PO/W-9.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

From: Emma Jordan <emma.jordan@brightpath.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@brightpath.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO, billing contact & W-9 for BrightPath Analytics

Hi Camila — thanks for the recap and the quote.

We will issue a PO for the renewal + capacity add. A couple of notes from procurement/finance:
- Billing entity: BrightPath Analytics, Inc.
- AP email: ap@brightpath.com (please send invoices to this address).
- Preferred terms: Net60 (we operate on Net60 for all renewals over $50k) — is that acceptable?

I'll attach our W-9 and the PO once approvals route through our procurement system. Expect the PO by early next week.

Also: please include the capacity add as a separate invoice line so we can match against our internal tag.

Thanks,
Emma Jordan
Director, Procurement | BrightPath Analytics
emma.jordan@brightpath.com | +1 646-555-3344

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath — Net60 request / billing contact update

Camila / Vivek,

Forwarding BrightPath's preference for Net60 and confirmation of AP email (ap@brightpath.com). They also asked for the capacity add as a separate invoice line.

Notes:
- Deal BRP-4821 — renewal + +10M tokens.
- Net60 requests are common at this ARR band; we should check whether accounting is comfortable with Net60 for a customer expanding capacity.
- We also need their EIN and completed W-9 to set up the account.

Camila: if legal/finance need a clause or invoice schedule we can offer a split invoice (50% renewal on 11/1, 50% capacity add 11/15) — won't change the Net due date but may help their matching.

Vivek: could you advise on the internal process & timeline to approve Net60 and create the billing account once we have the W-9?

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: BrightPath — PO & Net60?

Vivek — forwarding the customer's note. Recommendation: approve Net60 for BrightPath once we confirm W-9 + EIN and run standard credit checks. BrightPath has been a steady customer; expanding capacity now.

Action items for billing ops:
- Create billing account for BrightPath Analytics, Inc. once W-9 & EIN received.
- Set AP email to ap@brightpath.com and flag invoices to include a separate line for the capacity add.
- Once PO is received, please attach PO number to the deal in HubSpot (link below) and to the billing account.

Attachments: signed_sow.pdf (for reference).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BRP-4821

Thanks,
Camila

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-10T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: BrightPath — PO & Net60?

Camila / Rafael,

We can accept Net60 for BrightPath pending a quick credit check and receipt of the W-9 / EIN. Process & timing:
- Please have the customer upload the W-9 (w9_brightpath.pdf) and confirm the EIN. Once we have that, we will:
  1) Create the billing account in our billing system.
  2) Add AP email ap@brightpath.com as primary invoice recipient.
  3) Add PO metadata (when provided) to the HubSpot deal and the invoice template.
- I attached invoice_template_BRp-4821.pdf with fields we need populated for matching.

If the PO arrives before the W-9 we can provisionally accept the PO number but invoices will not be created until W-9 is on file (compliance).

Thanks — I’ll queue the account setup once we have the W-9.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Emma Jordan <emma.jordan@brightpath.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-12T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO, billing contact & W-9 for BrightPath Analytics

Hi Camila / Vivek — thanks for the patience.

We've issued the PO: BP-PO-88971 (attached). I've also attached our completed W-9 (w9_brightpath.pdf).

Please confirm once the billing account is created and whether you need any additional vendor information (bank details / remit address). Also, please ensure the invoice includes:
- Separate line for +10M token capacity add.
- PO number BP-PO-88971 on the invoice.
- Send invoices to ap@brightpath.com.

Attachments: PO_BP-88971.pdf, w9_brightpath.pdf

Best,
Emma Jordan
Director, Procurement | BrightPath Analytics
emma.jordan@brightpath.com
